description: This file defines the SettingsTab view in SwiftUI for an iOS app, implementing various configuration options and controls related to gateway connections, device features, and onboarding in the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: featureToggle
methods.description: Helper function to create a labeled toggle with an info button for device feature controls.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a discovered gateway asynchronously, updating UI state based on success or failure.

methods.name: connectLastKnown
methods.description: Attempts to connect to the last known gateway asynchronously.

methods.name: gatewayDebugText
methods.description: Generates a debug string comprising current gateway-related statuses and logs.

methods.name: lastKnownButtonLabel
methods.description: Builds a view label for the last known gateway connection button, showing progress or host:port info.

methods.name: syncManualPortText
methods.description: Synchronizes the manual port text input with the internal port number.

methods.name: applySetupCodeAndConnect
methods.description: Processes the setup code, validates, and initiates connection procedures.

methods.name: applySetupCode
methods.description: Decodes and applies a setup code, storing relevant credentials and connection info.

methods.name: applySetupURL
methods.description: Extracts host and port details from a URL and updates manual gateway settings.

methods.name: resolvedManualPort
methods.description: Determines the effective port to use for manual gateway connection based on current settings.

methods.name: preflightGateway
methods.description: Checks network reachability and validity for the specified gateway host and port.

methods.name: probeTCP
methods.description: Static method to asynchronously probe TCP connectivity to a host and port.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Attempts to connect manually to a gateway using specified host, port, and TLS setting.

methods.name: gatewayDetailLines
methods.description: Returns an array of descriptive strings about a discovered gateway's details for display.

methods.name: resetOnboarding
methods.description: Resets onboarding state, clears credentials, disconnects gateways, and resets UI state.
